title: Georgia State University
description: Georgia State University's official web colour guidelines define the primary colours Georgia State Blue (#0039A6) and White (#FFFFFF), and the secondary colours Red Accent (#CC0000), Blue Steel (#374057), Cool Blue (#0071CE), Vibrant Blue (#00AEEF), Light Blue (#97CAEB), Light Gray (#EEEEEE), Medium Gray (#CCCCCC) and Dark Gray (#767679).
